Watch for US rate cuts to extend the rally; add on any 3-5% dip.

Domestic liquidity and retail participation in IDX energy names amplify daily moves, creating tactical entry/exit windows for active investors.

sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: US solar manufacturers are structurally leveraged to AI data-center electricity demand, which is accelerating long-term PPA contracts and grid-scale deployments.
Indonesian renewables remain policy-bound, with the RUPTL revision and carbon market implementation the key catalysts for unlocking foreign capital and project pipelines.
Climate-tech supply chains are bifurcating: US names benefit from protectionist tariffs and reshoring, while Indonesian players depend on export competitiveness and domestic EV battery integration.
sectors.ai: Buy selective US solar equipment names (FSLR, SEDG, ARRY) on the AI-driven power demand and IRA tailwind, but stay underweight Indonesian renewables until clarity on PLN's procurement and tariff reforms; use the WATCH signal to add on dips, not chase.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG
themes: Halal-certified FMCG producers are gaining structural share as Indonesia's Muslim-majority population shifts toward certified products, driving premiumization and repeat-purchase loyalty.
Digital-native distribution via e-commerce and social commerce is compressing go-to-market costs for mid-cap consumer brands, enabling faster regional expansion and margin upside.
Rising middle-class protein and convenience demand is lifting processed-food and ready-to-eat sub-sectors, with local players outgrowing multinationals via localized taste innovation.
sectors.ai: Buy selective mid-cap consumer names on momentum, but avoid chasing ENZO/PADA post-spike; rotate into MBTO and ESTI for volume-backed re-rating. Watch IDX consumer breadth—if it holds above +1% for 3 sessions, add exposure; otherwise trim into strength. Favor names with export or halal-certified moats over pure domestic plays.

sectors.name: Crypto & Digital Assets
themes: Indonesia's pending crypto tax harmonization under OJK will force exchange consolidation, benefiting licensed local players and pushing volume to compliant offshore venues.

AI-agent tokens (PUMP, VVV) are early-cycle but face regulatory whiplash in emerging markets, making them tactical trades, not core holdings.
sectors.ai: Rotate into ATOM and AVAX as institutional staking narratives firm, but cap crypto at 3% of book and take profits on PUMP/HYPE into strength. Indonesia's regulatory vacuum favors OTC desks over retail exchanges—position via licensed Singapore rails. Hedge with ALGO options if macro risk-off spikes.
